about: One table for the display-language rule on both sides (integration rebuild, stage 1 fix round 2; RBS1-BEH-R2-2). 'syntax': a raw value and the tag it is as a language tag (language, then optional script, region and variants; canonical case), or '' when it is not one. 'write': a raw value and what JE may store or seed with the languages it ships (its locale files), or '' (Auto). The complete tag is checked before any exact or base-language match. Read by tests/backend/Api/ApiDisplayLanguageTests.cs (server save, first-read seed, reset) and tests/frontend/core/core-translations.test.mjs and tests/frontend/bootstrap/bootstrap.test.mjs (client).
